subject: Solution-fit & pilot playbook — next steps and kickoff coordination
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@cloudora.ai>, Jose Ramirez <jose@cloudora.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Solution-fit & pilot playbook — next steps and kickoff coordination

Hi Elena & Jose,

Thanks again for the demo today — great conversation. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we’re all aligned before we lock the kickoff: 

High-level pain & goal we heard
- Primary pain: noisy retrieval + hallucination on proprietary product docs when users ask complex workflow questions.
- Goal: reduce incorrect/irrelevant answers and get a baseline response accuracy we can measure against (see success metrics below).

Proposed pilot scope (4 weeks, focused)
- Ingest: 25k docs (PDF/text) from your knowledge repo, indexed for retrieval.
- Integration surface: a staging API endpoint for your UI and an optional embeddings sync to your vector DB.
- Workloads: 25k tokens/day synthetic + 5k user-originated queries.

Success metrics (measurable)
- Precision@1 on our eval set >= 85% (we’ll co-develop 150 labeled prompts)
- Average latency p50 < 200ms, p95 < 600ms under expected pilot load
- Reduction in hallucination — baseline false-positive rate drop >= 40% on the labeled suite

Owners & roles
- Cloudora: Elena (product lead), Jose (infra/infra-sec contact)
- Redwood: Mina (eng + engagement lead), Rishi Malhotra (infrastructure & access), Marissa Cole (evaluation lead)

Required access / pre-kickoff items (short checklist)
1) Read-only access to the staging document bucket (S3) or export share (ideally by 2026-12-18)
2) Service account for embeddings/ingest with IP allowlist (Rishi will share allowlist steps)
3) Sample user queries and success/failure examples for evaluation (Marissa will send a prompt template)

Proposed timeline
- Confirm scope & sign simple MOP: by 2026-12-18
- Kickoff call (30–45m): week of 2026-12-20 — we propose Tue 12/21 or Wed 12/22
- Week 1: ingest + baseline eval setup
- Weeks 2–3: iteration and prompt/eval tuning
- Week 4: acceptance run & wrap-up report

Attachments we’re including:
- cloudora_poc_mop.xlsx (pilot objectives & milestones)
- redwood_prekickoff_checklist.pdf (what to have ready)

Can you confirm the scope above and whether Tue 12/21 11:00am PT or Wed 12/22 9:00am PT works for the kickoff? Also please attach your security questionnaire if you have one so we can triage it with our security team.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Mina
---
Mina Haddad
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0138

From: Elena Soto <elena@cloudora.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Jose Ramirez <jose@cloudora.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Solution-fit & pilot playbook — next steps and kickoff coordination

Thanks Mina — useful summary and appreciated the structured playbook. A few quick clarifications from Cloudora: 

1) Timeline: our Q4 engineering freeze runs Dec 23–Jan 3. We can do an initial kickoff call in the week of Dec 20 as you suggested, but most of the hands-on integration work will need to happen after Jan 4. If that’s okay, we’d like a kickoff that focuses on scope, success criteria, and security kickoff (so teams are synced).

2) Security: attaching our baseline security questionnaire — Jose will own triage on our side. We need to understand how logs/queries are stored, retention, and whether inference traffic can stay within our VPC via private connectivity.

3) Access: we’ll generate a read-only role for a staging bucket and will include a service account. We’ll pair on allowlist IPs but also would prefer a short-lived VPN or VPC peering if your private deployment supports it.

4) Eval set: we can start building the 150 labeled prompts, but would like Redwood to propose a scoring rubric so we’re aligned on what constitutes a pass.

Proposed kickoff windows: Tue 12/21 11:00am PT (good) or Wed 12/22 9:00am PT (OK but prefer Tue).

Sharing the security questionnaire now.

—Elena
Elena Soto
Head of Product, Cloudora AI
elena@cloudora.ai | +1 (650) 555-0272
[Attachment: cloudora_security_questionnaire.docx (220KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Solution-fit & pilot playbook — next steps and kickoff coordination

Folks — forwarding Cloudora’s reply and questionnaire. Quick internal assignment: 

- Rishi: can you review the security questionnaire and confirm whether we can support VPC/VPN peering for a 4-week pilot? If not, propose the allowlist IP ranges + ephemeral service account flow. Also estimate how long to provision ingest credentials (target: 12/18).
- Marissa: please draft the evaluation rubric (precision / latency thresholds / labeling instructions) — I’ll share with Cloudora once you have a first pass. Aim for a 150-prompt template by EOD 12/17.

High-priority clarifications for the kickoff:
- Do we need a private deployment (customer-managed) for inference, or can we run on Hosted with a private network path? (Elena asked about VPC peering)
- Confirm acceptance criteria language (we’ll want a numeric threshold + a tie-breaker qualitative pass rate)

Reply with quick ETA on the two items above and any blockers.

Thanks,
Mina

Subject: Re: Solution-fit & pilot playbook — kickoff confirmed + pre-kickoff deliverables

Elena / Jose — thanks for confirming, and appreciate the questionnaire. Confirming updated plan and a couple of small changes based on internal review: 

1) Kickoff call confirmed: Tue 2026-12-21 11:00am PT (calendar invite sent). Agenda: scope & MOP review (15m), security triage (15m) with our infra/security reps, eval rubric overview (10m).

2) Security triage: Rishi will join and provide options for private connectivity. Short answer: we can support Hosted with a private network path (via secure peering) for the pilot; if Cloudora prefers a private-managed node we’ll scope that as an enterprise path (longer lead time). Rishi — please bring a recommended approach + provisioning ETA.

3) Deliverables and dates: 
- 2026-12-18: Cloudora to provide staging bucket access + service account (if possible) — if delayed, we’ll still proceed with kickoff focused on non-blocking items.
- 2026-12-17: Marissa to share 1st-pass evaluation rubric (attached draft).
- 2027-01-04 -> Integration window for hands-on ingest and iteration.

4) Attachments: added our pre-kickoff checklist and Marissa’s rubric draft for visibility.

If that all looks good we’ll treat kickoff as the official start of alignment; the actual integration sprint will follow your internal freeze. Appreciate the flexibility.

Best,
Mina
